---
title: "Reference"
subtitle: "Every setting the mobile-toc extension accepts."
description: "The filter entry, the styling custom properties, the language key and the cases where the extension does nothing."
---

## Configuration

The extension has no YAML options.
Add the filter, and turn on the table of contents:

```yaml
filters:
  - mobile-toc

format:
  html:
    toc: true
```

The button label is the title of the table of contents.
Set it with `toc-title`.
When the page has no title for the table of contents, the label is "Contents".

To turn the extension off on one page, set `toc: false` on that page.
The filter then adds no script and no style to the page.

## Styling

The extension reads CSS custom properties.
Each property has a Bootstrap fallback, so the button and the sheet follow your theme, in the light and in the dark colour scheme.
Set a property on `:root` in your own stylesheet:

```{.css filename="custom.css"}
:root {
  --mobile-toc-accent: #b3261e;
  --mobile-toc-inset-block: 4rem;
}
```

```yaml
format:
  html:
    css: custom.css
```

| Property | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--mobile-toc-bg` | `--bs-body-bg` | Background of the button and the sheet. |
| `--mobile-toc-fg` | `--bs-body-color` | Text colour of the button and the sheet. |
| `--mobile-toc-muted` | `--bs-secondary-color` | Colour of the title in the sheet header. |
| `--mobile-toc-edge` | `--bs-border-color` | Colour of the borders. |
| `--mobile-toc-active-bg` | 15% of the accent colour mixed into the background | Background of the current section in the sheet. |
| `--mobile-toc-accent` | `--bs-link-color` | Colour of the bar beside the current section and of the keyboard focus ring. |
| `--mobile-toc-radius` | `--bs-border-radius-lg` | Radius of the top corners of the sheet. |
| `--mobile-toc-inset-inline` | `1rem` | Distance from the button to the side edge of the screen. |
| `--mobile-toc-inset-block` | `1rem` | Distance from the button to the bottom edge of the screen. |

: Custom properties you can set. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[28,22,50]"}

To move the button away from another element, such as a chat bubble, change the two inset properties.

The script sets four more properties on `:root`: `--mobile-toc-offset-x`, `--mobile-toc-offset-y`, `--mobile-toc-offset-left` and `--mobile-toc-pill-height`.
The script owns them, and removes them when the button goes away.
Do not set them.

::: {.callout-note}
If a page is wider than the screen, the button follows the part of the page that you can see.
The "back to top" button of Quarto moves above the extension button, so that the two do not overlap.
:::

## Language

The label of the close button in the sheet comes from the `language` key `mobile-toc-close`.
The default is "Close".
Set the key in the front matter of a page:

```yaml
language:
  mobile-toc-close: "Fermer"
```

To set it for a whole project, add the key to a `_language.yml` file in the project.
The extension needs Quarto 1.11 or later to read a custom `language` key.

The extension has no other translations.
Quarto translates `toc-title` for its built-in languages, so the button label is translated when `lang` is set.

## Right-to-left pages

On a page with `dir: rtl`, the button is at the bottom left corner.
The inset properties still set the distance from that corner.

## Limitations

The extension adds no button in these cases:

- The format is not HTML with Bootstrap, for example Reveal.js, PDF, Typst or Word.
- The page has `toc: false`, or has no table of contents.
- The table of contents is in the body of the page, with `toc-location: body`, `left-body` or `right-body`.
- The table of contents has fewer than two links.
- The browser does not support the Popover API.
- The window is wide enough for Quarto to show the table of contents itself.
  By default that is 768 pixels or more, the `md` breakpoint of the theme (`--bs-breakpoint-md`).

The button and the sheet do not print.
When the reader asks for less motion, the sheet opens with no transition.

The extension works around a gap in Quarto: [quarto-cli#5961](https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/5961).
It is a workaround until Quarto shows the table of contents on narrow screens.
